results.name: Context Token Cost
results.formula: 100 · clamp((6000 − T) / 5400) per pattern; T = min(tokens of API+Config+Enum+Interface files, tokens of a ≥80%-complete manifest card)
results.summary: mean 438 tok/pattern (33 via cards); benchmark median 912

results.name: Prop Surface & Typing Precision
results.formula: 100 · (0.4·clamp(1 − max(0, props − 8)/12) + 0.6·precise/props); precise = boolean | number | enum/union | typed object/array | free string; a string validated with validateInRange or defaulted to an enum member is a stringly-typed enum (imprecise)

results.name: Machine-Readable Schema Completeness
results.formula: mean over manifest entries of the mean of six facets (props typed, defaults, api, events, cssClasses, markup) · 100 · (entries / patterns); 0 without docs-ai/osui.components.json
results.summary: 33/33 patterns in manifest; facet means props 100, defaults 100, api 100, events 100, cssClasses 100, markup 100

results.name: Type Strictness
results.formula: 100 − min(40, 4·implicitAny/KLOC) − min(20, 10·explicitAny/KLOC) − min(10, 2.5·suppressions) − 30·(exported public functions without return type / total)
results.summary: 0 implicit-any findings, 0 explicit any, 0 ts-ignore/expect-error, 0/422 public fns without return type (43.6 KLOC)

results.name: Documentation Coverage
results.formula: 35·(API functions with description + @param per parameter) + 15·(config props with a comment) + 0.5·agentDocs; agentDocs = 25·llms.txt + 25·llms-components coverage + 25·llms-tokens.txt + 25·llms-patterns.txt
results.summary: API JSDoc 348/348, prop comments 141/141, agent docs 100/100

results.name: Public API Shape Consistency
results.formula: 100 · (0.4·canonical members present/7 + 0.3·non-lifecycle functions returning the CreateApiResponse envelope + 0.2·camelCase parameters + 0.1·no inline error-code literals)
results.summary: 0 missing canonical members, 6 functions without envelope, 0 non-camelCase params

results.name: Markup Contract Depth
results.formula: 100 − 20·max(0, depth − 3) − 4·max(0, distinct elements − 6); measured on the deepest HTML template of the component's story; distinct = unique tag+classes signatures (repeated items count once)
results.summary: 81 components measured; mean depth 3.7, max 8; 22 without story

results.name: Design Token Semantics
results.formula: per component SCSS (compiled): 100 · (0.55·(1 − hardcoded/themeable) + 0.30·(reads via --osui-* API/themeable) + 0.15·clamp(1 − !important/(2% of themeable)))

results.name: CSS Selector Complexity
results.formula: per component SCSS (compiled): 100 · (0.6·clamp(1 − max(0, mean combinators − 1)/3) + 0.4·clamp(1 − max(0, p90 class-specificity − 2)/4))
results.summary: 3078 selectors in 99 files; mean depth 0.9, 212 selectors with ≥3 combinators

results.name: Composition Model & Standards Alignment
results.formula: 100 − 12·max(0, inheritance depth − 1) − 5·max(0, contract files − 4) − 15·(configs accepted only as JSON string) − 10·(event names typed as string) − 15·(global namespaces instead of ES modules)
results.summary: mean inheritance depth 1.8, mean 7.4 contract files; 0 JSON-string-only Create, 33 global-namespace APIs
